title: Turkish-Style Grilled Fish Kebabs
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for grilled fish kebabs with a Turkish twist, served with a side of herbal-infused rice.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of paprika, cumin, coriander, and sumac

ingredients.name: Aromatic Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: infused with garlic, lemon, and herbs

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Turkish Spices, Salt, and Aromatic Olive Oil.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the fish fillets.
Thread the fish fillets onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the fish kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the fish kebabs with a side of Herbal Rice and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped Fresh Parsley and serve immediately.
